purpose: Define metadata search, filtering, faceting and ranking as non-authoritative discovery projections over catalog entries, with exact result identities and governance-aware visibility.

owns: DWH Catalog Search and Discovery semantics

value.query_rule: Catalog search query/filter/facet profile is explicit.
value.result_rule: Search results return exact catalog-entry and underlying resource refs.
value.ranking_rule: Ranking/relevance is derived discovery evidence and not semantic priority.
value.visibility_rule: Search only exposes metadata permitted by catalog/access policy.
value.data_rule: Catalog discovery does not read underlying data unless a separate authorized preview/query is invoked.
value.facet_rule: Facets derive from explicit metadata fields/tags/classifications.
value.ambiguity_rule: Similar names never merge resource identities.
value.authority_rule: Search-result presence grants no data access or mutation authority.
